serialization: Row-major signed64 native input words, A then B then optional T; complex inputs Ar then Ai then Br then Bi. Outputs use signed little-endian u64 limbs per cell; complex real component then imaginary component. GF251 outputs are canonical0..250 serialized as one u64 each.

generator.zero_pattern: Generate each word normally, replace every value with0
generator.sparse_pattern: Generate each word normally, retain only operand-local indices divisible by8
generator.gram: Generate B as K observations by N=M features; overwrite A with its transpose
generator.generation2: Increment A[0] (Ar[0] for complex), except INT64_MAX decrements; GF251 increments modulo251. Gram also updates B[0]. All other inputs unchanged.

fixture_selection: --size tiny selects named fixtures only at2x2x3 with seeded pattern and no explicit seed or bits. Explicit seed/bits selects generator data instead. Exactness walkthrough always uses its five fixed witnesses.

gram_batch_v1.verification: One complete final native output outside every application batch and at the end of sustained timing; intermediate R duplicates are not independently audited.
